arms.name: baseline_corr
arms.xs_selection: top 200 absolute unweighted correlation with training-fold cross target
arms.history_selection: top 40 contemporaneous deviation correlation within XS 200

arms.name: market_task_aligned
arms.market_selection: top 200 training-only correlation between per-time unweighted feature means and per-time unweighted target mean

arms.name: xs_time_stable
arms.xs_selection: rank by median absolute correlation across contiguous training-time blocks multiplied by sign-consistency rate

arms.name: history_lag_aligned
arms.history_selection: rank candidate columns using causal previous, difference, rolling mean and rolling deviation association with the training-fold cross target

gates: positive in at least 4 of 5 folds
screening result must be confirmed with 3 seeds before any candidate packaging
do not expand the arm matrix after reading outcomes
do not generate a public CSV automatically
explicitly_excluded: same-sample LightGBM gain or SHAP selection without nested validation
